items.title: Ransomware Incidents Targeting Japan Increased by Approximately 1.4 Times
items.description: Japan experienced a significant surge in ransomware attacks during the first half of 2025, with incidents increasing by approximately 1.4 times compared to the same period in 2024. items.title: Microsoft Lays Out its Quantum-Safe Plans
items.description: The goal of the Quantum-Safe Program is to ensure that by 2033, all Microsoft products and services are safe by default from quantum-based attacks.
